text: SRAM co-founder Stan Day said in January 2019, as Ken Lousberg was named CEO, that SRAM will continue to be a private company owned by the Day family and the management team.
short: SRAM is privately owned by the Day family and the management team.

source.name: SGB Media - SRAM Announces Leadership Change
source.quote: SRAM will continue to be a private company owned by the Day family and the management team. It will continue to focus its innovation and business within the bike industry.
